descriptions.zh:
请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解法睿产品的收费方式和价格。

- 该接口需要开通法睿商品相关的后付费服务（开通免费），可以使用该账号的AccessKey和AccessSecret来调用我们的OpenApi服务

- 服务的响应结果是以流式的形式来返回（SSE）。

- 接口的调用需要阿里云百炼平台的工作空间权限。
descriptions.en:
Before using this operation, make sure that you fully understand the billing methods and pricing of the Farui product.

- This operation requires the activation of the pay-as-you-go service for the Farui product (activation is free). You can use the AccessKey and AccessSecret of the account to call the OpenAPI service.

- The response is returned in streaming mode through Server-Sent Events (SSE).

- Calling this operation requires workspace permissions on the Alibaba Cloud Model Studio platform.
